brief:
As the October olive harvest approaches, Palestinian farmers in the occupied West Bank face urgent need for international safeguards, according to Middle East Eye. The annual harvest transforms ancient olive groves into centers of labor and community activity across the region, making the period a critical time for Palestinian agricultural communities.

The opinion piece highlights the seasonal vulnerability of farmers during this traditionally important harvest period, though specific threats or incidents are not detailed in the summary provided.
dek: As olive harvest nears, Palestinian farmers urgently need international protection: Opinion by Fareed Taamallah Every October, the ancient olive groves in my hometown and across the occupied West Bank become dynamic hubs of life and labour.
title: Palestinian olive farmers seek international protection ahead of harvest season
